buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Department of Ocean Engineering and Naval Architecture Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur Paschim Medinipur West Bengal-721302 . 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 7 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 6. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 7. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 8. Generic Non return of Hard Disk: As per Buyer organization’s Security Policy,Faulty Hard Disk of Servers/Desktop Computers/ Laptops etc. will not be returned back to the OEM/supplier against warranty replacement. 9. Generic Malicious Code Certificate:

The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 10. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 11. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 12. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 13. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 14. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 15. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 16. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 17. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 5 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training,

Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 18. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC 1. Bidder should submit OEM Authorization specific to this bid with name, address and mail ID of the Signa tory to ensure their support for this work. 2. A certification from the OEM (in OEM Letterhead) stating that the Original OS (Windows 11 Pro 64 bit) wil l be preloaded before the supply of goods must be submitted with the bid. The Product Key of the Original OS (Windows 11 Pro 64 bit) against the serial number of supplied desktop PCs must be submitted on a ce rtificate by the bidder/OEM during installation and installation will not be deemed to be complete without this. A certificate should be submitted on OEM letterhead for the factory Pre-Loaded Operating System. 3. Technical Features, Drivers & Brochure: Should be available on the OEM WEBSITE. 4. As per the Buyer organization's security policy, the faulty Hard Disk of the Desktop Computer will not be returned to the OEM against warranty replacement. A certificate should be submitted on OEM letterhead. 5. The Technical Feature & Brochure of the model quoted should be submitted along with the technical bid , and additionally, must be available on the OEM website (URL should be provided with the technical bid) for verification. Drivers (Windows only) should be available for download from the OEM website for at leas t 5 years from the date of installation. 6. Bidder should submit OEM letterhead technical compliance and bid specific MAF on the OEM letterhead (mandatory) to this bid with name, address and mail ID of the Signatory to ensure their support for this w ork. 7. The location of the service centre should be within West Bengal. 8. The hardware must be fully compatible with the latest Linux and Windows Professional (Certificate to be included on OEM letterhead). 9. OEM must have a dedicated/toll-free Telephone No. for service support. Any service/support call raised must be attended within 24 hours by the bidder/OEM. Declaration to be included. 10. Bidder must have experience of supplying Desktop PCs to any Central / State Govt. Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company for a period of at least last 3 years before the date of submission of the bid. 11. Bid-specific malicious code certificate should be submitted on OEM letterhead. 12. Bidder must have ISO 9001 certification. OEM should have valid ISO 9001, ISO 20001, ISO 27001, ISO 14000 and Energy Star certificate / BEE certifications of the offered model. 13. Windows and Ubuntu/SUSE/Redhat Linux certification should be available in public domain. 14. .Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): An amount of Rs. 96,000 (Rupees Ninety Six Thousand only) (refun dable) in the form of Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’s Cheque (BC) paid in favo ur of “INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur must be submitted with t he bid. Any bid without EMD will summarily be rejected. No interest is payable on EMD. EMD will be refun ded to the unsuccessful bidder after finalization of the bidding process stage by stage i.e. Technical evalu ation and Financial evaluation. The EMD of the vendor awarded the contract may be treated as part of se curity deposit towards Performance Guarantee. EMD shall be forfeited if the selected vendor after award of the contract fails to execute the same. Bidders has to upload scanned copy/proof of the Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’ s Cheque (BC)aIong with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the buyer at below mentioned addr ess within S days of Bid End date/Bid Opening date. To The Assistant Registrar

Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur – 721302. 15. Payment Terms: i. 90% payment of the total contract shall be made after receipt of stores in good order a nd condition, successful installation and demonstration, thereafter certification of your bill by the concerned Head of the Department/ Centers/Schools/Units. ii. Balance 10% payment of the contract value may be released after warranty period or a gainst submission of Performance Security to the tune of 3% of the total Contract Valu e or on completion of warranty period. 16. Performance Security: Performance Security may be submitted in the form of Demand Draft/ Fixed Deposit Receipt/ Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) from any of the commercial banks in India and paid i n favour of “INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur to the tune of 3% of the total contract value. The PBG shall be valid for the period of warranty period plus 60 days. The p erformance security will be forfeited and credited to the procuring Entity’s account in the event of breach of contract by the contractor. The address for submission of hard copy of the Security Deposit is as follows : To The Assistant Registrar Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur – 721302. 17. Jurisdiction: All questions, disputes, or differences arising under, out of or in connection with the con tract, if concluded, shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction at the place from which the acceptance of Tender is issued i.e. Jurisdiction of KOLKATA HIGH COURT. Acceptance to this effect is also necessary at th e time of opening of Technical Bid. Important Note: Bidders should submit the following certificates as per Annexures 1. Declaration of Local Content as per Annexure-I 2. Certificate for Land Border Sharing as per Annexure –II; and 3. Undertaking regarding Blacklisting/Non-debarment as per Annexure-III The above-mentioned Annexures are available through Google through Google Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JeMbLQMKpwmiaI9SdGXImDzmRlxLstg6/view?usp=share_link
